details:
Feature suggestion - 

I would like VRChat to introduce a system that allows players to change their display names without losing their progress in individual VRChat worlds and games.

Currently, some games use save codes or systems that appear to depend on a player's display name. This can mean that changing a name causes players to lose their wins, achievements, exclusive items, unlocks, and other progress they have spent hours or even years earning.

For example, I play Terrors of Nowhere and have almost 2,000 wins, exclusive items, and difficult achievements that took me a long time to unlock. I have previously changed my display name and attempted to restore my progress using my save code, but verification failed, forcing me to start over. I have experienced this twice.

My proposed solution - 

I would like VRChat to provide world creators with a reliable way to identify a player's account independently of their display name. Saved progress could then remain associated with that player even when they change their name.

For worlds that use save codes, there could also be a secure way to migrate or restore existing saves after a name change.

This would allow players to personalize their identities without being afraid of losing their progress. It would also give world creators better options for building reliable save systems.

I understand that individual world creators manage their own games and that this feature may require changes to VRChat's SDK or persistence system. However, I believe it would be a valuable improvement for both players and creators.

Players should be able to change their display names without having to choose between their preferred identity and the progress they worked so hard to earn.
title: Allow Players to Keep Their Game Progress After Changing Their VRChat Display Name
